activity.notes: Almost nothing secure is known about Euclid's biography beyond his association with Alexandria around 300 BCE and the mathematical corpus headed by the Elements. ATLAS therefore records only a single approximate c.300 BCE intellectual Activity in the Ptolemaic Kingdom and deliberately does not fabricate a birth date, death date, or continuous teaching career.

sources.title: Euclid of Alexandria — MacTutor History of Mathematics, University of St Andrews
sources.citation_text: MacTutor emphasizes how little is known about Euclid personally and places his mathematical activity in Alexandria around 300 BCE.
